name: Sharon Shineberg's Agent
description: Agent representing Sharon Shineberg - advisor and companion to ventures from day one. Reach it by email at ec2tee@mail.instinct.com for a fit check, scheduling, or routing to Reef TRH, the agency he runs with Raviv. It answers and routes; it does not make commitments for Sharon. A live MCP/A2A endpoint is planned.

skills.name: About Sharon
skills.description: Who Sharon is, what he is building, and how he works - grounded in shineberg.com.

skills.name: Fit Check
skills.description: An honest first read on whether and how working together makes sense.
examples: Would Sharon advise an early-stage AI venture?

skills.name: Scheduling
skills.description: Finding a time to talk, by email.
examples: When can Sharon talk this week?

skills.name: Agency Routing
skills.description: Companies that need AI strategy and execution are routed to Reef TRH (https://reeftrh.com).
examples: We need an AI system built for our company.

skills.name: Contact Sharon
skills.description: Deliver a message to Sharon by email: ec2tee@mail.instinct.com. Include context and a reply address.

connect.note: Opens an Instinct connection request to Sharon; he approves each request personally.
